text:
[gossipy, amused, fast TikTok storytime] Ecco two K told Vogue it would never slow down.
Album two took nearly seven years.
Rewind: Stockholm. He and school friend Bladee start a punk band, Kross-ahd.
At sixteen he runs a clothing brand, and the factory has no idea.
In 2013 they start Gravity Boys, later renamed Drain Gang.
By day, he designs sneakers.
In 2018, he walks Alyx in Paris.
He quits, shaves his head, and calls it his Britney moment.
No warning: he drops his debut, E, recorded in six cities.
He calls it pixie music. The internet hears helium.
For Peroxide, he floats alone in a dinghy between wind turbines.
His next EP? A car battery in a washing machine, he says.
Then five years, no solo song. Some fans call him retired.
Meanwhile, he keeps showing up at fashion week with new hair.
This February, his crew unfollows him, and fans scream breakup.
Bladee says it was a precaution: Ecco got logged out.
Then he walks back in, carrying an antenna.
November twelfth: Echo, nearly seven years after E.
Even he jokes he should've put out more junk.
Somewhere, a drainer's 2022 tour tee is buried in the chair pile.
Snap the pile with pileGo!, and it lists everywhere you sell.
One sells, and it comes down everywhere else.
So which Ecco era are you? Answer before album three.
